<member name="M:Inno.Core.IO.AtomicDirectory.Publish(System.String,System.String,System.Threading.CancellationToken)">
    <summary>
    Publishes a complete directory at an unoccupied path without replacing an existing destination.
    </summary>
    <param name="source">
    The complete candidate directory, disjoint from the destination.
    </param>
    <param name="destination">
    The unoccupied publication path on the same filesystem.
    </param>
    <param name="cancellationToken">
    Cancels preparation or bounded waits before the rename commits.
    </param>
    <remarks>
    Windows access and sharing failures are retried for at most two seconds to tolerate temporary readers.
    Failure preserves the candidate and any existing destination. A committed rename is not canceled afterward.
    </remarks>
    <exception cref="T:System.ArgumentException">
    A path is blank or the two directory trees overlap.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.DirectoryNotFoundException">
    The source directory does not exist.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.IOException">
    The destination exists, the filesystem cannot rename the tree, or a transient block persists.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.UnauthorizedAccessException">
    The operating system continues denying access after the bounded retry window.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.OperationCanceledException">
    Cancellation is requested before the directory is published.
    </exception>
</member>

symbols.documentation:
<member name="M:Inno.Core.IO.AtomicDirectory.Install(System.String,System.String,System.Threading.CancellationToken)">
    <summary>
    Installs a disjoint candidate tree and restores the previous destination if installation fails.
    </summary>
    <param name="source">
    The complete candidate directory.
    </param>
    <param name="destination">
    The destination directory.
    </param>
    <param name="cancellationToken">
    Cancels preparation or bounded rename waits before the candidate commits.
    </param>
    <remarks>
    The caller must serialize readers and writers while the two directory moves run.
    Cancellation before commit restores the previous destination without canceling rollback.
    A committed candidate is not canceled afterward.
    Backup cleanup runs after commit; its failure preserves the installed candidate and remaining backup.
    </remarks>
    <exception cref="T:System.ArgumentException">
    Either path is blank, or the candidate and destination trees overlap.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.DirectoryNotFoundException">
    The candidate directory does not exist.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.IOException">
    Installation fails before the candidate becomes authoritative.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:Inno.Core.IO.DirectoryCleanupException">
    Installation committed, but the old backup could not be removed. The installed tree remains complete.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.UnauthorizedAccessException">
    The operating system denies access before the candidate can be installed.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.AggregateException">
    Installation and restoration both fail; neither tree is deleted to force a rollback.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.OperationCanceledException">
    Cancellation is requested before the candidate commits; any moved previous tree is restored.
    </exception>
</member>

<member name="M:Inno.Core.IO.AtomicFile.Install(System.String,System.String,System.Boolean)">
    <summary>
    Atomically installs an existing same-directory candidate file.
    </summary>
    <param name="source">
    The complete candidate file beside the destination.
    </param>
    <param name="destination">
    The destination file path beside the candidate.
    </param>
    <param name="overwrite">
    Whether an existing destination may be replaced; false never overwrites an external creator.
    </param>
    <remarks>
    A failed create-only publication preserves the candidate. After successful publication the
    candidate is removed; a subsequent cleanup failure reports that the complete target exists.
    Unix create-only publication requires same-directory hard-link support. The caller must own
    the candidate and parent directory until the operation completes.
    </remarks>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.IOException">
    Publication fails, create-only mode finds an existing destination, or candidate retirement
    fails after the complete destination has been published.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.PlatformNotSupportedException">
    The host does not provide an atomic create-only filesystem primitive.
    </exception>
</member>

<member name="M:Inno.Core.IO.FileLease.AcquireAsync(System.String,System.TimeSpan,System.Threading.CancellationToken)">
    <summary>
    Waits for exclusive ownership without blocking an owner thread or changing shared data.
    </summary>
    <param name="path">
    The absolute lease file path; all participants must use the same persistent path.
    </param>
    <param name="timeout">
    The maximum wait, or <see cref="F:System.Threading.Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan"/> for no time limit.
    </param>
    <param name="cancellationToken">
    Cancels waiting before ownership is returned.
    </param>
    <returns>
    The exclusive lease whose disposal permits the next participant to acquire ownership.
    </returns>
    <remarks>
    Lease files remain after disposal. Removing them would let Unix processes lock different
    inodes for the same path while an earlier participant still owns the original inode.
    </remarks>
    <exception cref="T:System.ArgumentException">
    The path is empty or relative, or the timeout is negative and not infinite.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.TimeoutException">
    Another participant retains ownership beyond the permitted wait.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.OperationCanceledException">
    Waiting was canceled; no lease is returned.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.IOException">
    The lease cannot be opened for a reason other than competing ownership.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.UnauthorizedAccessException">
    The operating system denies access to the lease path.
    </exception>
</member>

<member name="M:Inno.Core.IO.ProcessOwnedDirectory.CreateForProcessAsync(System.String,System.String,System.Threading.CancellationToken)">
    <summary>
    Creates a directory protected by this process lifetime when the caller can retain only file metadata.
    Payload consumers in other processes must register their lifetimes before using it.
    </summary>
    <param name="root">
    The absolute producer root; existing directories are never adopted.
    </param>
    <param name="identity">
    A current operation's explicit 32-digit hexadecimal directory identity shared by its process participants.
    </param>
    <param name="cancellationToken">
    Cancels before the process claim is transferred.
    </param>
    <returns>
    The new directory, preserved until every recorded process exits and the producer retires it.
    No managed lease object is retained by the caller.
    </returns>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.IOException">
    Ownership cannot be established within the boundary.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.ArgumentException">
    The producer root or current operation identity is invalid.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.InvalidDataException">
    An existing operation claim is malformed, inactive, or cannot authorize this process.
    </exception>
</member>
